replace_with_jit: monkey patch BERT and RoBERTa transformer modules to replace forward methods with TorchScript-compatible Jit versions
undo_replace_with_jit: restore original BERT and RoBERTa transformer modules by undoing the TorchScript monkey patch
BertModelJit: use the TorchScript-compatible BertModelJit class to run a BERT forward pass with typed tensor inputs
BertSelfAttentionJit: use the TorchScript-compatible BertSelfAttentionJit class to compute self-attention scores with scriptable transpose and softmax
RobertaEmbeddingsJit: use the TorchScript-compatible RobertaEmbeddingsJit class to compute RoBERTa token embeddings with fairseq-style position indexing
